title: A wish to keep forever
excerpt: I hate the notion of people believing in motion, Of how incessantly they seek changes How insisting they are about life erosion I detest those who fault the bon...
content: I hate the notion of people believing in motion,
Of how incessantly they seek changes
How insisting they are about life erosion
I detest those who fault the bonds of love and trust
The way they defy the existence of eternity
How firm they are that forever is long lost
How passive and naive are they to those feelings
The true ones that hearts purely forge
Deep within, with selfless motives and willingness
Have they not been through those moments?
Whence in bliss of love, your heart fills up
In glow of glee, your life it ornates ..
For forever and eternity are not just words,
Of lasting for ever and ever as they seem
They are more an emotion, a bond - a feeling of sorts
Of rather choosing what is present, to be as is,
And always to be whenever possible!
And even if it can't be as we please,
To keep hope that it is not impossible!
In faith by living our life the way it is
We choose to make forever plausible!

title: Fears in Love
excerpt: What am I afraid of you'd asked I choose not to say the darkness Or even the depths that come with height For it's the sparks that shine less The absence of you...
content: What am I afraid of you'd asked
I choose not to say the darkness
Or even the depths that come with height
For it's the sparks that shine less
The absence of you just gives the fright
What am I worried of you'd asked
The times when you feel a bit distant is the thing
A bit lonesome, a bit off and silent
The moment when you're not your true being
For I loathe this silence,
That brings forth a whirlpool of emotion
Some of distress, some of guilt and rest - the ache
For feeling so helpless, not being your solution
But I still love to be a part of it
For it is the togetherness with you, I care of
Even if it feels a bit gloomy, not lit
It's the sunshine you bring I crave of
And it's just you with me that gives the joy
Of all the darks and brights we share of!

title: Drenched in love
excerpt: Is it not quite obvious? My glance - as I stare into those eyes of yours Hours and hours, like I could plunge so deep In depth of feelings, that almighty force!...
content: Is it not quite obvious?
My glance - as I stare into those eyes of yours
Hours and hours, like I could plunge so deep
In depth of feelings, that almighty force!
Is it not too mystic?
The level of closeness, this level of trust
Day by day, as we talk through those talks
Even those, in silence whence we are just..
Indeed, it is beautiful,
You and your warmth, to wrap me through
Minute by minute, as you pass my thoughts
Drenched in your love, that's so true..

title: Of Depth
excerpt: I was unbeknownst of the concept of depth Of what it entailed or of the limits portrayed I had not known the meaning of the word, of whats that left Until I was...
content: I was unbeknownst of the concept of depth
Of what it entailed or of the limits portrayed
I had not known the meaning of the word, of whats that left
Until I was shown, the gravity it played
For what seemed like mere stares of those green eyes
Have found a profound meaning of deep love in display
What seemed like mere simple hold of your hands
Feels more like the depth of trust in play
Had I not known, what would the feeling of being close to you feels like
Would I ever be known, how being deep in love feels like?
Had I not felt, how our fingers entwined together feels like
How would I know how depth in the gentleness feels like?
For now I feel me drowning into the depths of it
Depth as deep as the ocean below
Depth as deep as the skies above
Depth as deep as the universe at times
And most importantly, depth as deep as your warmest embrace, my love
Well my heart now floats in those depths like never before
Has it learnt to swim like you did I wonder
For I don’t think it craves for shore - no more
Safe haven it found and finds yonder
For in the depths, our hearts they merge
In a place like heaven, they wander
In a place like heaven, they wander

title: कस्तो अचम्म छ है
excerpt: कस्तो अचम्म छ है, यो पिरती र प्रेमको रंग हेर न, कति उजेली छ है यसको आभा अनि सुगन्ध भावना मात्र ठानेकी थिएँ पहिले यो त केवल भावना नहुँदो रहेछ मात्र बचन मानेकी थि...
content: कस्तो अचम्म छ है,
यो पिरती र प्रेमको रंग
हेर न, कति उजेली छ है
यसको आभा अनि सुगन्ध
भावना मात्र ठानेकी थिएँ पहिले
यो त केवल भावना नहुँदो रहेछ
मात्र बचन मानेकी थिएँ जहिले
यो त जिउनु कै असाये पो बनिसकेछ
सायद शून्यता को स्थितिमा पनि
उसकै उपस्थिति देख्नु रहेछ माया
सायद हासोको असीम लहर बनी
उसकै खुशीमा डुब्नु रहेछ माया
लाग्दो रहेछ, आज उसको आँखा मा हेर्दा
आफ्नै मुहार हेर्न पाए हुदो हो
अझ दुःख र पीडाले घेर्दा
उसकै हात समाउन पाए त हुदो हो
एक एक पलमा उसको सम्झना
साथमै हुँदा पनि अपुग हुने मिलन
हरेक रातमा उसको कल्पना
अपुरो हुँदा पनि किम्ती त्यो सामीप्यपन
कस्तो अचम्म छ है
यो पिरती र प्रेमको रंग
हेर न, कति उजेली छ है
यसको आभा अनि सुगन्ध
यसको आभा अनि सुगन्ध

title: I Miss the you and me!
excerpt: I wondered how often did the land meet the sky As a bow of bands made a bridge across them two I wondered how often did the bird made it so high High enough to...
content: I wondered how often did the land meet the sky
As a bow of bands made a bridge across them two
I wondered how often did the bird made it so high
High enough to meet the sun and wave it too
If only meets were as easy and often as we wish
But it takes more than just time and will, you see..
As only a single glimpse of you could be a bliss
Togetherness is what I miss, I miss the you and me!

title: Till death do apart

content: I might be unlovable,
Bit difficult at times
A bit irrational
Illogical sometimes
I could try to win you
Over arguments with tears
Over confusions with fears
Instead of being the fierce
I could try to win you
For your love and your care
That I will never share
To none who shall dare
But I promise to keep you
Closest to my heart
For Always and forever
Till death do apart ❤️

title: The Sun and the Sunflower
excerpt: With you, my dawn begins With you, I prepare for dusk In immense joy I bloom in full Breaking out the husk I sway along the winds in day With warmth of yours in...
content: With you, my dawn begins
With you, I prepare for dusk
In immense joy I bloom in full
Breaking out the husk
I sway along the winds in day
With warmth of yours in play
I turn around as you just turn
And play along with me in fun
The gloomy days are hard of all
For I crave of you - or glimpse
In hopes I outgrow up so tall
But harsh the rain just seems
I yearn for your gentle caress
I yearn for you to touch
I yearn for your love in bless
I yearn for you so much
That I could wait for winter through
To bloom again in spring in true
As the sunflower in love with you
You're my sun in view
As the sunflower in love with you
You're my sun in view...

title: Pouring it all out...
excerpt: Dear Love, I feel the sounds of each words you speak deep in my heart Those sounds you utter that make me glee, despite sometimes they hurt Together with you, t...
content: Dear Love,
I feel the sounds of each words you speak deep in my heart
Those sounds you utter that make me glee, despite sometimes they hurt
Together with you, time stays still like it never had to have flown before
Together with you, heart beats in pace like it never seems to know of more
In you, I find my comfort - of silence, of the mundanes and the regular
For you, your presence is my comfort zone, though you - my special, my spectacular
Could I outpour all my feelings out to you, and feel a bit lighter in my heart?
Could we really outbeat against all odds, and make it all a big worth?
But the more I pour, the more it grows, the more it tends to show out loud
But I care no more, to hide 'em in depth, this love that I entrust - I'm proud
Expressing my love for you - all aloud!

title: The first of feelings
excerpt: I love the rhythm that this heart beats As you gaze upon those eyes of mine And just let them talk in silence I fond the way that this heart leaps With joys whe...
content: I love the rhythm that this heart beats
As you gaze upon those eyes of mine
And just let them talk in silence
I fond the way that this heart leaps
With joys whenever it hears your voice
And happy it feels right since
I like it how you share your days with me
Of daily chores to dreams and life
As though our lifes are connected
I believe it they are somehow, or will be
For this trust, this bond and vibes too strong
Feels all wrongs been corrected
I love the way that it all makes me feel
Like everything that I've wanted has become real
And I dream of nothing further
I hope the urge is more than enough to heal
Of all the pasts we've been through and dealt
For now it feels better than ever
So much better than ever

title: Imperfect
excerpt: Sometimes in life I need not the perfect I need not the best, nor them to be all set I prefer the blurred, The wretched and The crooked as I am too For what I s...
content: Sometimes in life I need not the perfect
I need not the best, nor them to be all set
I prefer the blurred,
The wretched and
The crooked as I am too
For what I see best is
The effort, the feels - if is true
All I need is mere a validation
Of your presence, your touch, and your words
The existence of this relation
Little bits of love against all the odds
Coz Sometimes in life I need not the perfect
Rather your love, your time, like times we'd met
Like times that we had met!

title: Happy Times
excerpt: Let me get lost into those rhythms The beats that your heart played As you swayed by the pier winds With eyes closed and hands held Tell me one of your stories...
content: Let me get lost into those rhythms
The beats that your heart played
As you swayed by the pier winds
With eyes closed and hands held
Tell me one of your stories
Ones where you're happy the most
And sing me one of those melodies
To groove together like we're lost
And look me into my eyes
When I call upon your name and smile
With those glistening depth of ones you've got
Not just parting away for a while
And as the sun sets in the paradise
Let's chase those streaks so bright
For there's no times like times with you
So happy, so warm, so right!

title: The Day you were Born
excerpt: In the moment, where I'd lost my balance and tumbled You gripped my hands to steady me up, While I waited for the light to pierce through my darkness You brough...
content: In the moment, where I'd lost my balance and tumbled
You gripped my hands to steady me up,
While I waited for the light to pierce through my darkness
You brought the lumen to cheer me up!
I was disgraced on my own perception,
Lost and hopeless - in my own inception
But your mere presence and your feel just lit me up;
Your love, the joys and tears we've shared,
I feel lucky enough, you lift me up!!
Is it just the haze in your eyes? I guess a no..
It was more than just your dashing looks to chase
Was it your personality; gesture or the care you show
That I started caring for you in a million ways.
Still remember the day - you had walked away,
Hurt in heart, I was insecure I'd lose you then
But who would have thought it would turn this way
Beautiful as it is, like the sun after the rain!
And now, we are like those blossoms in the spring
Happily together, sharing our tales and dreams
As merrily we deal with issues and moods we swing
No distance could block those rays or beams!
So I choose this day to show my gratitude for you..
For showing up and always being the best I own,
As I promise to never let go nor give up all through
I thank the god for it's the day you were born!
The day you were born!

title: Jacaranda, and You
excerpt: I wished to be in your embrace More like them branches spread wide And shield me from the drops of rain You protect me as beneath I lied And like them flowers f...
content: I wished to be in your embrace
More like them branches spread wide
And shield me from the drops of rain
You protect me as beneath I lied
And like them flowers falling down with grace
Slowly touching, caressing me as they fall
Shower me with your infinite love too
As I summon those eyes, your name I call
For your eyes, they melt me from within
The hue with depth - I would risk a dive
And in those depths, like branches of trees
Woven is your beauty - so intricate, so live
I wish we stayed a little longer
The purple path - along the jacaranda line
With silence, pure joy and smiles in heart
Wish I held you for longer, as your hands held mine
For with you by my side, I find myself alive
Rejunevating like them the old trees, full in blow
Blooming in glee, happy in love - I often shine
Perennially beside you, I wish to be,
With more love in bestow, just love in bestow ❤️

title: The Sun and The Moon
excerpt: I quench my thirsts of wanderlust In the rays and hues of dusk and dawn When the rays of the sun hits that eternal spot It feeds my soul with utmost joy and fun...
content: I quench my thirsts of wanderlust
In the rays and hues of dusk and dawn
When the rays of the sun hits that eternal spot
It feeds my soul with utmost joy and fun
I feel the connection somehow
With the warmth I drench myself in the day
As if I have been hugged tight in your embrace
Is it mere a coincidence in the name, in play?
For you are as fierce and bold as the sun
But heart bleedingly soulful like them sunsets
Calm and peaceful as the morning glares
So loving and caring, as no one even gets
While I am the moon, seeking your presence
For my radiance, my glow is your grace
And without the rays, I lose myself in the dark
You are the reason to the smile on my face
And like the sun and the moon are always on sync
I promise to look up to you in the depth of darkness
Never giving up, despite our nature and differences
I choose to love you forever and ever, nonetheless
Nonetheless ❤

title: Happy V Day!
excerpt: This day just feels the same, Just like it had always been. No magic in the air, No star dust of feels and love. The charm I've never seen. It's the day of love...
content: This day just feels the same,
Just like it had always been.
No magic in the air,
No star dust of feels and love.
The charm I've never seen.
It's the day of love,
It's the day of depth,
At least that's what they said.
But even with you, my love,
It feels the same.
Or is it too special, in my head?
I wished to be there with you,
I thought we'd spend the day,
Hold your hand in my hand,
Your arms I wished to lay.
Just doing nothing,
And saying everything.
I wished to hear from you
The tales of when I met you,
And tales before it too.
We'd laugh upon our mistakes,
And cry with tears of joy.
And in between those good times,
I would have found my boy.
We'd go chasing the sunset,
As day wrapped along the shore.
And with the end, we'd hug tight,
And kiss from depth of core.
Like I mean it with my life,
Like I mean it with my soul.
I'd seen it in my dreams — this day,
But was it not just a foul?
For it's the day of Cupids again,
And yet I am all alone,
Despite having you to love,
The love that can't be shown,
The love that I can't just own!

title: Love is Weird
excerpt: Isn't it weird? How you can complicate things with feelings, And yet you feel so vivid? Isn't it weird? How you can weaken yourself over someone, And yet you fe...
content: Isn't it weird?
How you can complicate things with feelings,
And yet you feel so vivid?
Isn't it weird?
How you can weaken yourself over someone,
And yet you feel so intrepid?
What is it in this trust?
This level of ecstasy..
That you behold everytime?
What is it in this belief?
Or the way how it has turned ..
Into a habit with time?
But it feels lucky,
To be cared and so pampered
With moments they bring
And it feels so amazing,
To be lost in the rhythms
Of hearts as they sing

title: Beauty of Love
excerpt: Like a meticulously crocheted piece of warmth, With a thousand intricate patterns woven aesthetically With the perfectly matching colors in sync The depth of il...
content: Like a meticulously crocheted piece of warmth,
With a thousand intricate patterns woven aesthetically
With the perfectly matching colors in sync
The depth of illusion - it created magically
Such is our times - of being together
A little blend of ecstasy and happiness all over
With a subtle touch of melancholy at times
Both infused, all together - in unison to make it better
Like you are the sunshine to my darkness
Bestowing me the galore of reasons to be thankful for
But as the clouds roll upon and deep you hide
I bellow and grieve for those times to be over
And as the sun shines bright again
My heart leaps up in joys you’ve never felt
It’s the amalgam of happiness and pain
You see,
In days of togetherness we’ve dealt
and all the feelings we have felt!

title: Without you
excerpt: It's not the same Those gloomy days, with no sunshine When the sun hides through along the time It's not the same Those times without your presence, your smile...
content: It's not the same
Those gloomy days, with no sunshine
When the sun hides through along the time
It's not the same
Those times without your presence, your smile
When wait for your glimpse takes a while
As time passes by, the more I feel the absence
The more I choose to suffer, the more I suffocate
As I think of you, the more I feel your presence
Even though not as near, I still can relate
In every turns of those bending pathways
As I made the swerve along the roadways
I could see the beam of sunshine in the haze
Dim in hue yet so bright, just like your rays
Even through the silence of the distance
I could hear you at times through my heart
Or is it just my illusion, I wondered in instance
For little do these hearts want to stay apart
Restless and tensed throughout the time
I think of you, with every cell in my brain
For this outpours, this box of love of mine
I suffer without you, I hide no pain
So, it's not the same
Those nights and days, without your grace
When I just yearn to see that face
My sunshine, my joy
That gleaming face!

title: The vow
excerpt: When it comes to being yours only I agree, I might not be your perfect I might not be your beauty-in-chase I might not be your right mate While I chose to choos...
content: When it comes to being yours only
I agree, I might not be your perfect
I might not be your beauty-in-chase
I might not be your right mate
While I chose to choose you all along
I agree, I might not be your first choice
I might not always be there to sing your song
I might not always be in the rejoice
If there is something, I can promise to you
I agree, I shall not give up at all cost
I shall keep this love as much as true
I shall keep up to gain all your trust
For it's the best of what has been
I agree, I will protect us from all
I will cherish this love as our win
I will always choose to stay small
Instead of drowning, after we fall
I will make sure, together we stand tall
Breaking the stares of questions - those walls
I will make sure, this love never falls

title: Reunion
excerpt: IN THE EVERY MOMENT OF WHERE I AM NOW I CHOOSE TO RELIVE THOSE TIMES AGAIN WHEN WE HAD BEEN TOGETHER ALL IN GLEE AND TIMES THAT WERE MUCH MORE INSANE AND AS I C...
content: IN THE EVERY MOMENT OF WHERE I AM NOW
I CHOOSE TO RELIVE THOSE TIMES AGAIN
WHEN WE HAD BEEN TOGETHER ALL IN GLEE
AND TIMES THAT WERE MUCH MORE INSANE
AND AS I CHOOSE TO REMEMBER YOU
I WISH SOMEWHERE DEEP IN MY HEART
HOW WOULD IT HAVE BEEN IF YOU'RE HERE
AND IF WE HAD NOT BEEN MILES APART
BUT RIGHT THEN,
IT FLASHES - MY MOBILE SCREEN
WITH YOUR NAME ETCHED; LIKE ITS ON MY MIND
IN ECSTASY MY SMILE RETURNS
MEMORIES THEY FLASH AND UNREWIND
NO MATTER HOW FAR OUR WAYS HAVE BEEN
I LOVE IT HOW YOU'RE ALWAYS THERE
AT TIMES I NEED, WHEN I MISS YOU TOO
SO FAR - CONNECTED BUT YET NEAR
LIKE YOU'VE ALWAYS BEEN RIGHT THERE
WITH ME TOGETHER RIGHT NEXT HERE!

title: Not so simple, is it?
excerpt: I used to think life was simple than it was thought to be Like you could just turn it off them senses and everything in place - it's ought to be I would just pr...
content: I used to think life was simple than it was thought to be
Like you could just turn it off them senses and everything in place - it's ought to be
I would just pretend sometimes like those complexities did not exist in life
I would just prevent the times when those atrocities put my vigor in strife
Like an ostrich hides the head in the sand
Like a child that dances off with the music band
I just made life easier by making it simply easier
Nonetheless, but now
Life is not as simple as it somehow used to be
The infinite road that we planned together is far to further till I see
But I still believe in you with all my heart
That we would still hold on till death did us apart
For no matter what life brings forth, no matter how its dark
It's you and me, and our invigorating spark
Till times unlived and times unknown
Together we deal - this life as we own!

title: Denial
excerpt: Like a pinch of sugar in a cup of hot tea Or a dust of caffiene over that hot mocha chai Like the sweetness of cherry on the top of cake Or the dust of light su...
content: Like a pinch of sugar in a cup of hot tea
Or a dust of caffiene over that hot mocha chai
Like the sweetness of cherry on the top of cake
Or the dust of light sugar on top of that hot cookie
Such is you smile, such is your warmth
As you make a way through my heart and claim it all over
Who would have thought a heart so broken, so wrecked
Would ever be picked up and fixed up again
Piece by piece and meet after meet
You make the gestures undeniable
And yet you deny to comprehend
The beauty of this all?

title: My Heart Wrenches
excerpt: My heart wrenches With the thought of losing you. A slight distance thought Passes through— That you will leave me someday, And all that glittery gold Is just a...
content: My heart wrenches
With the thought of losing you.
A slight distance thought
Passes through—
That you will leave me someday,
And all that glittery gold
Is just a dust,
That smoulders with my tears,
And with the wind
It all perishes away.
One day
You will just be a distant memory,
Every time we spent together
Just a story
That I will keep repeating
Again and again,
But just in my head,
My dreams,
And my thoughts only.
For one day
You will leave me adrift
On my own glory,
And I know
The exact amount of pain
I will go through that day—
Just a hundred
Or thousand times more
The pain
I’ve gone through.
For you live
In my days,
My nights,
And the in-betweens,
But that day
I’ll have you lost
By all the means.
I shake
As I see the day
In clear sight sometimes—
On days you hate me,
On times
When none shines.
When no matter
How much I love you,
Your heart
Will not approve,
Blocks all my feelings
Just to disapprove.
I see immense hatred,
I see immense guilt,
For having me
In your life
With nothing
But regret.
And that’s when
I sense my worth in you,
And my heart
Always wrenches
With the thought
Of losing you.

content: तिम्रो मौनतामा पनि खै के धून सुन्छु म
जुन धूनले सारा मन नै तरङ्गीत छ

सून्दर त त्यो मन र स्वभाव छ
तिम्रो ऑखाको गहिराईमा हराउछु म जब
ती भावना पढ्न खोज्दछु
त्यो मन्द मुस्कानको पर्खाईमा सॅधै
तिमीलाई भेट्ने बहाना म खोज्दछु
शब्द माथि शब्द गर्दागर्दै आज
तिम्रो समिप भए कि खै
महत्वपूर्ण भएछौ तिमी आज
यो साथ कहिल्यै न छोड्नु है?

title: Please, hold on
excerpt: Hold on, will you? No matter, what comes forth No matter, how hard it proves I promise to make it worth And it's you, that I choose Just hold on.. Don't ever le...
content: Hold on, will you?
No matter, what comes forth
No matter, how hard it proves
I promise to make it worth
And it's you, that I choose
Just hold on..
Don't ever let the rain wash away
The glee, the brights of days
Don't let the wind make them sway
The love, the moments in chase
For what it takes, is not the effort
Or the plays of times and luck
It's all about the will, the support
The need - to perfectly make it work!
And for that, just hold on, will you?
Tight yet loose at the same time
Just perfect enough, I'll hold on too
With all my love, and every time!
